items.title: Freedom Broker cuts PayPal to Hold as branded checkout stalls
items.summary: Investing.com -- Freedom Broker downgraded PayPal to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $63 from $72 in a note Wednesday, saying the payments company’s branded checkout business has failed to reaccelerate.

items.title: Block Soars 14% on Raised 2026 Outlook, Says AI Shift Has “Meaningfully Crossed the Chasm”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBlock shares jumped 14% on a strong third quarter and higher 2026 guidance. Its first 2027 outlook calls for at least 15% gross profit growth and a 32% adjusted operating margin.

items.title: HP Taps Former GSK Executive Emma Walmsley as Next CEO
items.summary: HP said Walmsley, who was at the helm of drugmaker GSK from April 2017 until the end of 2025, will join the Palo Alto, Calif., company on Jan. 4.

items.title: HP Names Emma Walmsley as New CEO, Ending Monthlong Search
